onFaint.line: YOU COME ROUND BY THE SHELTER'S FIRE, A SMELL OF WET FUR AND BERRIES. BIG FOOTPRINTS LEAD AWAY INTO THE SNOW. SOMETHING CARRIED YOU HERE.

interactions.label: FLAT STONE
interactions.dialog: A FLAT STONE BY THE BOULDERS, BERRIES LAID OUT ON IT IN A NEAT ROW. SOMEBODY WITH VERY BIG HANDS WAS VERY CAREFUL.
